atomic_facts.fact: The legal name of the entity is Northvolt AB
The GLEIF record shows entity status ACTIVE
The GLEIF record was last updated 2025-08-22, so the ACTIVE status holds as of that date
The statement comes from Northvolt AB's own website (northvolt.com)
The website states Northvolt AB filed for bankruptcy in Sweden on 12 March 2025
The filing followed exhaustive efforts to secure a viable financial future that did not succeed, i.e., failure to secure new financing
No corporate registration number (organisationsnummer) for Northvolt AB appears in the consulted sources
